requirement_coverage: Test cases only verify request count limits, not the 'per minute' time-based constraint.
correctness: Test steps do not verify the time-based nature of the limit, only the count.

test_cases.title: Send 100 requests within 1 minute
preconditions: Valid API key is available
test_steps: Send 100 requests to the API endpoint, ensuring the total time taken is less than 60 seconds.
test_cases.expected_result: All requests return a 200 OK status code.

test_cases.title: Send 101 requests within 1 minute
preconditions: Valid API key is available
test_steps: Send 101 requests to the API endpoint, ensuring the total time taken is less than 60 seconds.
test_cases.expected_result: The response status code is 429 (Too Many Requests).

test_cases.title: Verify Retry-After header on limit exceed
preconditions: Valid API key is available
test_steps: Send 101 requests to the API endpoint within 60 seconds and inspect the response headers.
test_cases.expected_result: The response contains a 'Retry-After' header.

test_cases.title: Verify Retry-After header value on limit exceed
preconditions: Valid API key is available
test_steps: Send 101 requests to the API endpoint within 60 seconds and inspect the 'Retry-After' header value.
test_cases.expected_result: The 'Retry-After' header contains a valid integer value indicating the time to wait.

test_cases.title: Verify limit resets after 1 minute
preconditions: Valid API key is available
test_steps: Send 100 requests within 60 seconds, wait 61 seconds, then send 1 request.
test_cases.expected_result: The request returns a 200 OK status code.

requirement: Each API key shall be limited to 100 requests per minute. Exceeding the limit shall return a 429 status code with a retry-after header.
